decision_rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting through a shared city, misdates a posting, or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked first); Confirmed otherwise. Unreachable only if the source cannot be reached at all. Line drawn: off-page descriptive facts inside a stated value are corrected; bookkeeping labels ('listed, not counted', 'none found', 'no dated plant-level event') are not.
error_rate_note: Headline on the R2 basis (rows flagged r2_basis: every stated row, every row of a claim a score row cites incl. its unknown/'none found'/inferred rows and the three v-enclosures-battery-generator:demand_outlook rows, and the 3 opening lines): 8/77 = 10.4%. Strict (also counting two borderline confirms: c-psi:bottleneck 'constraint is space' paraphrasing 'space-intensive', and GPC existing_robots resting on a two-location Robotics Technician requisition): 10/77 = 13.0%. Stated rows only: 7/62 = 11.3%. All 139 rows written: 8/139 = 5.8%. Every quote whose page was reachable was found on a fresh fetch (visible text or raw source); 0 unreachable. The 6 Census rows show synthetic query-summary quotes; re-queried and confirmed, not counted as quote failures. No correction changes a score component, a tier or a counted posting; all 8 are attribution or wording (two company overviews tagged stated at a five-facility company, two compound/judgement clauses from another page or a geocode, one plan written as current, one descriptive name label, one opening line overstating an optional spec item). Over 10% on the headline, but on a small basis (3 plants). Sensitivity: 7/77 = 9.1% if the two GPC products rows (one boilerplate pattern on two pages) count as one error.
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (7) - same patterns as R2-G and R3-I: (a) company overview or company web page product lists tagged stated as a plant's products at a multi-site company (GPC MIG Welder requisition overview and gpcwordpress page; the overview text is repeated verbatim in every GPC requisition, including Burnham ones); (b) compound values carrying a clause from a sibling page (c-global-power-components:production_type UL 142 clause; PSI weld_processes 2026-04-02 clause); (c) a scoring/site judgement and a geocode distance inside a stated triggers row; (d) a hiring plan ('we are adding a CWI at each facility') written as current; (e) an opening line generalising an optional spec item to 'each enclosure'. SWEEP suggestion: for battery profiles whose products rows cite a job-posting 'Overview' paragraph (GPC style boilerplate), re-tag or prefix 'company-level'.

rows.note: The line says Pritchard Brown 'custom designs each enclosure and builds it on a welded steel floor and underframe'. Spec 2130 is a 'shall' specification (undated, 2021/12 upload) and makes the floor/underframe optional ('optional floor/underframe'; heading 'Floor/Underframe/Rupture Basin (if applicable)'; drop-over enclosures have no floor/underframe/tank and use a tie-down frame instead), so 'each ... builds it on a welded steel floor' is not supported. Both stated rows it cites (production_type, materials spec row) are on their pages. The inferred bottleneck row repeats 'beneath each'. Corrected line composed only from stated claims p-pritchard-brown-baltimore-md:production_type (about-us 'Each enclosure is custom designed') and p-pritchard-brown-baltimore-md:materials (spec 2130: 'an optional floor/underframe incorporating prepainted aluminum stressed-skin semi-monocoque construction'; 'The floor and underframe assembly shall consist of fabricated steel or structural steel welded to form the outer perimeter.').
